_comment: Mutation testing scaffold. Removing a try/catch or sentinel-compare line should be killed by the security regression test suite. Run with `bun run mutation` (full run is slow, ~5-15 min; not part of CI by default) or `bunx stryker run --mutate src/<file>.ts` for one file. `tsconfigFile` deliberately names a file that does not exist: Stryker's tsconfig preprocessor calls `ts.parseConfigFileTextToJson`, which TypeScript 7 no longer exports, and our tsconfig `extends` a package specifier so nothing needs rewriting. Test files must NOT be in `ignorePatterns` - that removes them from the sandbox; the `mutate` list already keeps them unmutated.
